title: Financial 15 Split Corp. Preferred Share Rate
description: Financial 15 Split Corp. announces that the Preferred Share dividend rate for the fiscal year commencing December 1, 2024 will be set at 8.50%, down from the previous 9.25%. The company invests in a portfolio of 15 North American financial services companies.

title: Toronto’s WNBA Team Builds Bench Strength With New Front Office Hires
description: WNBA Toronto has hired two experienced professionals, Whitney Bell as Chief Marketing Officer and Lisa Ferkul as Chief Revenue Officer, to help build the team's brand and commercial partnerships ahead of its debut in the 2026 season.

title: 2 High-Yield Financial Stocks to Buy Hand Over Fist and 1 to Avoid
description: The article discusses three high-yield financial stocks: Annaly Capital Management, Toronto-Dominion Bank, and Bank of Nova Scotia. It cautions against Annaly Capital Management due to its volatile dividend history, but recommends TD Bank and Scotiabank as relatively low-risk turnaround plays with high yields.

title: Buffett's Bank Stock Strategy: Is His Profit on Bank of America a Reason to Invest in These Promising Banking Turnarounds?
description: The article discusses Warren Buffett's investment strategy in bank stocks, particularly his profitable investment in Bank of America during the Great Recession. It also examines four other banks - New York Community Bancorp, Toronto-Dominion Bank, Bank of Nova Scotia, and KeyCorp - that are currently undergoing turnaround efforts and may present investment opportunities for investors to follow Buffett's playbook.

title: The largest family medicine gathering in Canada takes place in Vancouver in November
description: The College of Family Physicians of Canada is hosting the Family Medicine Forum 2024, a four-day event that will bring together family doctors from across Canada and around the world to celebrate family medicine. The event will feature an educational program, networking opportunities, and an exhibit hall showcasing the latest advancements in medical technology and healthcare solutions.

title: Le plus grand rassemblement de médecins de famille au Canada aura lieu à Vancouver en novembre
description: The Family Medicine Forum (FMF) 2024, organized by the College of Family Physicians of Canada, is the largest gathering of family physicians in Canada. The 4-day event will feature educational sessions, networking opportunities, and an exhibition hall showcasing the latest advancements in medical technology and healthcare solutions.

title: Dividend Select 15 Corp. Declares Monthly Dividend

title: Prime Dividend Corp. Monthly Dividend Declaration for Class A & Preferred Share

title: North American Financial 15 Split Corp. Monthly Dividend Declaration for Class A & Preferred Share

title: Premium Income Corporation Announces Class A Consolidation Ratio
description: Premium Income Corporation is consolidating its Class A shares and changing its Class A share distributions to a monthly schedule. The consolidation will ensure an approximately equal number of Class A and Preferred shares outstanding. Holders of Class A shares will continue to have leveraged exposure to a portfolio of major Canadian banks.

title: L’OSBI devient l’unique ombudsman bancaire pour les clients canadiens des banques sous réglementation fédérale
description: The Ombudsman for Banking Services and Investments (OSBI) will now be the sole external complaints handling body for all federally regulated banks in Canada, simplifying the complaint resolution process for consumers across the country.

title: OBSI Becomes Sole Banking Ombudsman for Canadian Customers of Federally Regulated Banks
description: The Ombudsman for Banking Services and Investments (OBSI) has been designated as Canada's sole External Complaints Body for banking, streamlining the complaint resolution process for consumers. This change aims to address inefficiencies and complexities faced by consumers when escalating banking complaints.

title: 3 Top High-Yield Bank Stocks to Buy in November
description: The article discusses three high-yield banks - KeyCorp, Toronto-Dominion Bank, and Bank of Nova Scotia - that are currently undergoing turnarounds but offer attractive dividend yields. The author suggests that long-term dividend investors may find these banks worth adding to their portfolios.

title: Here Are My Top 2 High-Yield Bank Stocks to Buy Now
description: The author is buying shares of Toronto-Dominion Bank and Bank of Nova Scotia, two Canadian banks with high dividend yields, despite their current challenges. The author believes the banks are well-regulated and will weather their temporary issues, making them attractive long-term investments.

title: Scotiabank Announces Dividend on Outstanding Shares
description: Scotiabank announced a dividend of $1.06 per share, payable on January 29, 2025, to shareholders of record on January 7, 2025. The bank has suspended the discount to the Average Market Price for dividend reinvestments and stock dividends under its Shareholder Dividend and Share Purchase Plan.

title: 1 Magnificent High-Yield Bank Stock Stock Down 25% to Buy and Hold Forever
description: Bank of Nova Scotia, a major Canadian bank, has a high dividend yield of nearly 5.4% but has lagged its peers due to its focus on Latin America. The bank is now shifting its strategy to reduce exposure to less desirable markets and increase exposure to the U.S. market, which could improve its performance in the long run.

title: CORRECTION: Scotia Global Asset Management announces estimated year-end cash distributions for the Scotia ETFs
description: Scotia Global Asset Management announced the estimated year-end cash distributions for the Scotia ETFs listed on the Cboe Canada Exchange for the 2024 tax year. The final cash distribution amounts will be announced on or about December 30, 2024.
